Restaurants with good ratings and a minimum ground elevation

Cajun/Creole, Cafes, and Arts & Entertainment, connected through Yelp restaurant labels. Ground elevation at or above the category-group 10th percentile; Yelp business stars at least 4.

-0.60 m10th-percentile elevation cutoff

10th percentile means a lower cutoff. It retains roughly 90% of restaurants by elevation before applying the rating filter. It does not select the highest-elevation 10%. Negative elevations can qualify when the cutoff is negative.

Category inclusion and overlap

A business must have the exact Restaurants label and match at least one of the three selected labels. A business matching multiple labels is counted once in the combined group. Arts & Entertainment describes an experience rather than a cuisine; the overlap counts below make that distinction visible.

All boundary areas are included, even when Selected and Qualifying are zero. Percent is the share of selected-category restaurants in that area that qualify. Any unmatched restaurants are shown separately rather than reassigned to a nearby polygon.

Where the qualifying restaurants are

Hover a polygon to see its area name and statistics, or a dot for restaurant details. The downloadable PNG versions are saved alongside this report.

Neighborhood Statistical Areas

Census tracts (2024)

Use neighborhoods to communicate recognizable destinations and census tracts to inspect smaller spatial patterns. Areas with only a few qualifying restaurants provide limited evidence for an area-wide recommendation. Maps show restaurant concentrations, not restaurant density per square kilometer.

Main-analysis choice: neighborhoods. They provide recognizable area names and group restaurants into fewer sparse comparisons. Of the 40 occupied neighborhoods, 25 have fewer than five qualifying restaurants; the tract comparison has 54 such areas among 69 occupied tracts. Small groups still need careful interpretation.

Methods, coverage, and sources

  1. Yelp input: the complete saved New Orleans business subset (6215 businesses). This subset was filtered using Yelp city = New Orleans and state = LA. Closed businesses are retained because no current-open restriction was requested; the table shows snapshot status.
  2. Categories: split comma-separated labels, normalize whitespace and capitalization, and match exact labels. Require Restaurants plus at least one chosen category. The research theme can be framed as dining with local flavor, cafe culture, or entertainment.
  3. Elevation: query the USGS 3DEP bare-earth elevation service at each selected restaurant coordinate using bilinear interpolation and the first available raster value. Preserve raster ID, source name, vertical datum, resolution, coordinates, and UTC query time in the cache. Ground elevation is measured in meters; feet use 3.280839895 feet per meter. Small differences should be interpreted in light of source accuracy.
  4. Cutoff population: all 618 selected-category restaurants with a finite elevation, before filtering ratings. Use R quantile type 7 at probability 0.10 (-0.603745 m), then keep elevation >= cutoff and business stars >= 4. Missing elevations: 0.
  5. Neighborhoods: the City of New Orleans Neighborhood Statistical Area layer. Tracts: U.S. Census 2024 cartographic boundaries for Orleans Parish, downloaded through tigris, at 1:500,000 scale. These simplified tract/place polygons can leave coastal or boundary-adjacent points unmatched. Use full TIGER/Line polygons if a boundary-sensitive decision requires greater precision.
  6. Spatial assignment: transform points and polygons to EPSG:26915 and apply strict sf::st_within(), with no snapping. Compare against the independent 2024 New Orleans place polygon; 7 selected restaurant coordinates fall outside that simplified city polygon. Keep these records and report unmatched assignments rather than silently deleting them.
  7. Coverage: qualifying restaurants span 40 neighborhood areas and 69 census tracts. The qualifying set contains 103 businesses marked closed in the Yelp snapshot. Ratings reflect the downloaded dataset, rather than a live check of current restaurants.
  8. Scope: this report uses Yelp business stars and review counts. It does not yet implement individual-review or reviewer-normalization analysis required elsewhere in the assignment.

Reproduce: run geographic_analysis.R. Cached inputs are in data/geography/. CSV tables, analysis RDS, and map PNGs are in results/geography/. The HTML embeds all figures and works offline.

Prepared from the local Yelp snapshot and official public geospatial services. Query timestamps are preserved in the elevation cache.
